plain_text:
Parley Baer appears in 713 recordings across 36 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1947 to 1979. The credits here include performer and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Parley Baer most often in Gunsmoke, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Tales of the Texas Rangers, Escape, Sears Radio Theater, NBC University Theater, This Is Your FBI, and The Railroad Hour.

Characters credited here include Chester Proudfoot.
